prompts.dragon-scorch-rifle.png: Create ONE original inventory and held-weapon sprite for the user's original mod weapon named 龙灼线束 (Dragon Scorch Beam), a pulse laser rifle powered by an experimental dragon-breath energy cartridge. The attached tiny vanilla rifle image is a STYLE/SCALE/ORIENTATION reference only. Design a substantially new sci-fi silhouette, retain the readable simple low-resolution side-view pixel-art language and earthy charcoal/titanium grey palette. Strict orthographic side profile pointing RIGHT, stock left. Compact utilitarian industrial titanium body, squared vented emitter shroud in place of a normal rifle barrel, small recessed ember-orange energized slit, one short dark removable energy cartridge under the receiver, restrained copper/brass accents, readable grip and stock. All features made of crisp square pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no gradients or realistic rendering. Visually aim for a 48 by 18 pixel logical sprite, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges in the output. A single isolated complete item, moderate narrow transparent margin, no floor, no cast shadow, no labels, no lettering, no watermark, no muzzle beam. Keep a genuinely transparent background. Return the final image saved as a local PNG file if supported.
prompts.dragon-breath-cell.png: Create ONE original pixel-art inventory sprite for an Experimental Dragon-Breath Cell (实验性龙息单元), the removable 1000-energy cartridge of a sci-fi pulse laser rifle. The attached tiny rifle magazine image is a STYLE/SCALE/ORIENTATION reference only. Make a newly designed short vertical cartridge with a subtly angled lower edge and clear battery-like top contacts, titanium dark grey casing, two recessed amber/ember-orange charge windows, tiny copper connector, robust sci-fi construction appropriate for titanium and biochemical fluid fuel. Strict flat side-view orthographic pixel art. Crisp square pixel clusters and restrained high-contrast shading, earthy charcoal/titanium palette to match a gritty low-res 2D survival game. Visually aim for a 12 by 22 pixel logical sprite, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor pixel edges in output. One isolated complete cartridge centered, close fitting transparent margin, genuine alpha transparency, no background, no shadow, no text, no numerals, no glow outside the silhouette, no photorealism, no smooth gradients. Return the final image saved as a local PNG file if supported.
